ios.name: Halcyon — Sleep Tracker
ios.subtitle: Fall asleep in 10 minutes
ios.promotionalText: New: weekly sleep debt, and a wind-down reminder that adapts to your bedtime.
ios.description:
Halcyon turns last night into one clear decision for tonight.

WHY IT WORKS
• One score you can act on, not a wall of charts
• Deep, core and REM stages with the confidence band shown
• On-device analysis — nothing leaves the phone unless you export it

HOW IT WORKS
1. Put the phone on the mattress and start the night
2. Wake to a score and the three inputs that moved it
3. Get one suggestion for tonight, based on your own data

No ads, no data resale. Subscription required after the free trial; cancel in two taps.

Questions? support@example.com
ios.whatsNew: First release: nightly scoring, stage breakdown, and one actionable suggestion each morning.
